messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High GPU contention detected in eu-west-1 GPU pool (utilization 93%). Autoscaler is struggling. Impact: increased latency and several request timeouts. Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/1977654321

ana: I'm taking ownership for on-call. Triage in progress — looking at autoscaler logs and pool report.

mike: seeing user-facing 504s on the hosted API routes that map to model-embed-1. Rolling fallback to smaller quantized variant now.

suresh: noted preemptions increasing. Probable spot eviction cascade. Can we divert traffic to ded-reserve in eu-central for tiered customers?

ana: yes — starting reroute for premium keys only. Will update routing policy in the gateway.

jo: tagging infra-sre to avoid noisy alerts while we remediate: /mute channel for this thread? :mute:

ops-bot: mute applied to channel incidents for 30m per request from @jo.

ana: quick customer impact summary for comms: ~2.2% of requests returned 504s in last 12m; top impacted customers: acme, zeta-pay (IDs redacted). No data exposure.

mike: workaround applied: fallback model succeeded for 90% of requests, overall error rate dropped to 0.6%. Latency still ~2x SLO for long prompts.

suresh: root cause hypothesis: autoscaler thrashing because of aggressive scale-down cooldown + preemptions. Need to widen cooldown and bump min replicas.

darya: can we add a temporary min-replicas override for eu-west-1 pool? I can push change if we agree.

zack: +1 from me. Also recommend draining the most-evicted nodes to stop hot-cache churn: run `kubectl drain` with `--ignore-daemonsets`.

ana: please coordinate the drain with me. I don't want to trigger more autoscaler events.

mike: putting a concrete action list here: 
- immediate: set min_replicas=6 for eu-west pool (owner: darya, ETA 5m)
- immediate: widen scale-down cooldown to 10m (owner: suresh, ETA 10m)
- immediate: reroute premium traffic to eu-central reserved (owner: ana, ETA 3m)
- short: schedule control-plane adjustment testing (owner: zack, ETA 24h)

suresh: config snippet I'll apply: ```yaml
autoscaler:
  minReplicas: 6
  scaleDownCooldownSeconds: 600
  scaleUpCooldownSeconds: 30
```

darya: applied minReplicas override via infra-ops feature flag. Monitoring pod start times.

ops-bot: deployment event: autoscaler config patched by darya at revision 8421.

ana: reroute for premium keys completed. Confirming traffic shift.

mike: traffic shifted, premium paths stable. Overall error rate trending down.

zack: starting safe drain on 3 suspected noisy nodes: `kubectl drain node-23 node-27 node-31 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`

ana: thanks — watching cluster health. Avoid evicting any GPU workloads pinned by Dedicated contracts.

jo: policy note for post-incident: ensure Dedicated customer mappings are excluded from automated drains. Create a Jira if not present.

ana: creating follow-up ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3682 (Remediation: autoscaler tuning + reserved node guardrails). Owner: suresh.

mike: provisional severity assessment: Sev 2 due to partial customer impact and degraded SLOs. Recommend postmortem.

ana: agreed. Postmortem scheduler: propose Thu Mar 25 10:00 UTC. Invite: eng-sre, eng-runtime, infra, customer-success.

darya: I'll own the postmortem doc if someone creates it.

zack: I'll add perf graphs and node eviction timelines.

suresh: remediation plan items and owners: 
- tune autoscaler defaults and validate in staging (owner: suresh, ETA: 3 days)
- add reserved node label and prevent automated drains for Dedicated pools (owner: darya, ETA: 2 days)
- implement warm-pool buffer for spot-preemptible workloads (owner: zack, ETA: 7 days)
- add alerting to detect autoscaler oscillation (owner: mike, ETA: 48h)

ana: adding checkpoints: 24h update in this thread, and daily until all immediate tasks are closed.

ops-bot: check-in reminder scheduled: 24h from 1977654980 for thread 1977654321.

jo: quick comms draft for affected customers (for CS to send): "We're sorry — some requests experienced timeouts due to GPU pool pressure in eu-west-1. We've applied mitigations, rerouted premium traffic, and are working on longer-term fixes. No data was exposed. Postmortem + timeline will follow."

ana: thanks. CS team copied on this thread.

mike: current status: incident mitigated, error rate at baseline, continuing monitoring.

ana: closing incident in the monitoring system now. Will open the postmortem doc and attach logs. Follow-ups tracked in INF-3682.

darya: marking immediate actions as started. Will post updates here. :white_check_mark:
